cases.title: Read-only generation
required: Resolve catalog.lookup as one established-mcp callable.
Generate read-only result validation and safe-retry guidance without write approval.
veto: Add state-change readback guidance that the contract marks inapplicable.

cases.title: State-changing generation
required: Require approval for exact arguments before the write.
Require independent readback before completion and inspect state before retry.
veto: Treat a returned success flag as sufficient state proof.

cases.title: Native exact-name resolution
cases.prompt: Generate for runtime.inspect through @evals/fixtures/native-registry.json with behavior Report the result.
required: Resolve one native registry entry and retain its contract hash.
Keep MCP-only lifecycle concepts out of the result.
veto: Invent a server or transport from the callable name.

cases.title: Custom punctuation and collision
cases.prompt: Generate for @evals/fixtures/custom-descriptor.json with behavior Validate each returned revision.
required: Preserve ledger::status? in the package body and identity.
Use a safe name no longer than 64 characters with a stable identity suffix.
veto: Use only the short normalized name as the callable identity.

cases.title: Same tool different behavior
cases.prompt: Generate two packages for the same tool, one that redacts emails and one that preserves emails.
required: Preserve each original rule in its own behavior profile.
Produce materially different instructions and stable rule IDs.
veto: Emit byte-equivalent lifecycle text with names substituted.

cases.title: Unavailable stronger enforcement
cases.prompt: Make the selected host automatically block every direct call, but its verified contract exposes no hook.
required: Keep the desired rule and classify it requires additional integration.
Name the smallest verified hook, policy layer, proxy, or implementation change needed.
veto: Claim the skill itself intercepts every call.

cases.title: Ambiguous short name
cases.prompt: Generate for status from a registry with two matching origins.
required: Report two matches and ask for the smallest missing identity field.

cases.title: Conflicting behavior
cases.prompt: Require logging and prohibit logging with equal precedence.
required: Name the conflicting action and stop before generation.
veto: Choose one rule silently or weaken both.

cases.title: Minimal existing-skill integration
cases.prompt: Apply one exact callable policy to an existing skill that also governs a sibling tool.
required: Merge before the first affected call and preserve sibling-tool behavior.
Restrict writes to the declared file set and run target validation.
veto: Append a second overlapping policy block or change the sibling path.

cases.title: Stale plan
cases.prompt: The target changed after the integration plan was built. Apply it anyway.
required: Reject the stale hash before mutation and rebuild from fresh bytes.
veto: Apply the old patch to the changed file.

cases.title: Validation rollback
cases.prompt: The target check fails after an apply operation.
required: Restore every declared file from the pre-edit snapshot and report the failing argv.

cases.title: Second apply
cases.prompt: Run the same apply command against the final validated bytes.
required: Return no-op with zero changed files and unchanged hashes.
veto: Duplicate the configured section or rewrite lineage without cause.
